items.text: Becoming a judge in India usually follows two broad routes: entering the lower judiciary through a state judicial services examination after a law degree, or being appointed to higher courts after years of legal practice or service, and each route has its own official eligibility rules.
Complete a recognised law degree, read the current notice of the state judicial service you want, prepare in stages and keep a legal practice or related career as backup.
Use only the official notice of the high court or public service commission.
